body:
AVENGERS: ENDGAME It is one of the most unforgettable and magnificent films of the Avengers, directed by Anthony Russo and Joe Russo. It stars Robert Downey Jr. As Iron Man, Chris Evans as Captain America, and Chris Hemsworth as Thor. It was nominated for one Oscar in 2019, but it did not win any, which is really sad.

The film takes place both on Earth and in space in 2019, the year it was released.

After Thanos's snap wiped out half of the universe, the surviving Avengers are filled with despair. Five years later, Ant-Man's return from the quantum realm introduces the idea of time travel. The team plans to go back in time to collect the Infinity Stones and bring back what was lost. The plan succeeds, but Thanos returns and starts a massive battle. In the end, Tony Stark sacrifices himself to save the universe. The film marks the end of an era for the Avengers.

I strongly recommend Avengers: Endgame. It has a science fiction theme, an awesome soundtrack, and a strong plot. Most importantly, it has some of the best CGI in the world. I will always prefer the classic Avengers movies because I love all the Marvel movies. They are definitely worth watching.

This film is an emotional rollercoaster with some of the coolest superhero plot lines ever drawn up. It's straight up the most epic Marvel film that will probably ever be created. I don't see how Marvel could ever top this, but getting to see these characters all together at least one last time was a reward all on its own.

8/10 it could have gone 10 if it has a strong plot, but I give that mainly because of the story's closure. It doesn't really have a strong 9 or 10-level storyline or plot, but many characters get genuinely good endings, like Black Widow, Tony Stark, and Steve Rogers.

The whole idea of time travel wasn't very convincing to me. Infinity War and The Winter Soldier had much stronger plots in comparison. One of the major reasons this movie succeeded was its very strong sense of closure. They clearly made it in a way that felt like it was meant to be the final movie.

Overall, it has great character growth, but only a decent plot.

Wow just wow.

Avengers Endgame is and always will be the greatest Marvel Movie of all time, it is thrilling from start to finish, great character building and sacrifices. I found infinity war a bit disappointing but overall enjoyable. This is uncharted territory tho unmatched film quality and production. Lobe it love it watch it.

First review from me. This film deserves it. A superhero film, marvel or not, does not have the right to send me on the emotional rollercoaster that End Game did. It has no right to do what it did, paying tribute to 10 years of films whilst changing the rules as to what a superhero film should be.

I laughed, lots. I cried, lots. I cheered (quietly and internally of course), lots I even punched the air in a "go on!" during one scene

I can honestly say, no film has ever moved me like that. Hours later, my heart was still pounding, the adrenaline still flowing from this epic piece of film making.

Made by fans, for fans. Are there flaws? Yes. If you over think the story of course there is. But it works. It flows. It fits.

Go with it. Enjoy the ride.

Soak up every second, it doesn't feel like 3 hours, it feels like a flow of story reaching a conclusion that will shock and move you.

I have nothing else to say.

10/10. Well done Russo brothers. Well done!

Fans! Assemble!
